notes: Gate requires allowed_sources.json and validates non-empty allowed_sources list.
Scoring is skipped when no upstream target is available; gate degrades PASS to WARN in that path.

scoring_skipped.condition: no upstream_dir and no staged target

scorer.execution_condition: upstream_dir or staged target directory exists

current_scorer_verifier_integration.lineage_usage: passed into verifier via --lineage when available

warning_and_blocker_representation.score_signals: score_summary contains metrics but does not directly set BLOCK unless verifier fails

optional_rule_pack_integration_points.why: Allows rule-pack findings to influence verdict mapping with full scorer/verifier context.
optional_rule_pack_integration_points.risk: Must preserve canonical verifier precedence and deterministic ordering.

optional_rule_pack_integration_points.why: Advisory embedding path with zero verdict change.
optional_rule_pack_integration_points.risk: Lower risk, but less useful for warn/block policy modes.

optional_rule_pack_integration_points.hook: external companion run referenced by gate
optional_rule_pack_integration_points.why: No coupling to gate internals; easiest rollback.
optional_rule_pack_integration_points.risk: Dual-run orchestration complexity and path drift risk.

family_specific_coupling_risks: Generic gate may become WCD-specific if family rules are hardcoded instead of plugin-driven.
Heuristic checks (vendor-token, terminology) can over-warn unrelated driver families.
Runtime-sensitive LA-to-LE policies differ by subsystem; generic blocking could overreach.
Rule-pack versioning drift can destabilize deterministic gate output unless rules are pinned by path+hash.
